ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High density of mid-to-high intensity light-gray speckled pixels covering approximately 75% of the visible surface against a low-intensity dark-gray/black base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Diffuse, high-frequency light-gray mottling across the interior of both lobes; solid low-intensity black banding concentrated along the trailing edges and lower central peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with pixel-level jagged peaks extending across the entire linear boundary of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast, heterogeneous clusters of white and brown pixels (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips; minor jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density salt-and-pepper pigmentation pattern across the entire ventral surface.
